book.name: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela
book.title: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela Buk Song—Psalms

content.text: O Maaron, yo kinik tsiau.
Yau aat nayoor ghom, ve napait ezam pa poia tsio. Ta aazne, ve taghon taghon gha ila.
Onoon kat, saawe isov, yau aat napakur ghom pa poia tsio.
Pale napait ezam ta aazne, ve taghon taghon gha ila.
Yoova eeza tiina kat. Isaav ighe tapaiti, ene iduduuŋ.
Tapiri tomania ŋgar ve poia tooni, ene tiina le tiina kat.
Ighe tagham ŋgar pani, ene aat tarao mako.
Uraat ariaŋazi ve ŋgar popoia tau ughamgham zi na, tamtamon pale tisavia vaaru pa natuzŋa, ve natuzŋa pale anazi tisavia pa paaghu toozi, ve iseeŋga tauvene gha ila.
Pale tipait ezam, ve tisavia mbonarim tiina tau ipabood ghom na.
Ve uraat tsio ŋgeretazi tau maata ite kat na, yau monmon naghamgam ŋgar pani.
Yo utotoi tapirim ila uraat tsio ariaŋazi tau igham tamtamon tiroi. Tauta pale tisavia vaaru.
Ve uraat tsio tintiina, yau aat nasinaia.
Poia tsio, ene tiina kat.
Tauvene tamtamon pale matazi iŋgalŋgali ve tivovotia vaaru.
Pale timbou toman lolozi poia, ve tipait ghom pa ŋgar tsio duduuŋa.
Yoova ighamgham poghani ghiit, ve loolo isasaghatin ghiit.
I aate yavyav rekrekia mako.
Poia tooni, ene tiina kat. I loolo isaghav ghiit ariaaŋ, ve iuluul ghiit irau saawe.
Yoova ighamgham ŋgar poia pa tamtamon tisov.
Ve loolo isasaghatin gabua naol isov tau i ighur zi na.
O Yoova, gabua naol isov tau yo ughur zi na, pale tisov lolozi poia payo ve tipait ghom.
Ve tamtamon tsio tau lolozi isaghav ghom ariaaŋ na, yes pale tipait ghom pa poia tsio.
Pale tisavia pooz tsio tighe ene gabua tiina ve poia.
Ve tivotia varum tighe yo tapirim tiina le tiina kat.
Leso tamtamon tisov tiwatagh uraat tsio tintiina tau itotoi tapirim.
Ve tighilaal tighe pooz tsio, ene gabua tiina ve paghuuna kat.
Pooz tsio ighengheen tauvene irau saawe.
Gabua naol isov pale tileep ila yo sambam, ve uŋgin zi taghon taghon gha ila.
Yoova itataghon saveeŋ tooni isov.
Ve uraat tooni ta naol ne, titotoi tighe i loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni ariaaŋ ve iuluul zi.
Yes tau aghezi pusukia ve tighe titap, i ikiskis zi tuŋia.
Ve tamtamon tisov tau pataŋani itatan zi na, i iuul zi, ve iit zi tizaa.
Gabua isov tau matazi yaryaare na, matazi ilatlat payo.
Saawe tau pitool zi, yo ugham lezi aniiŋ.
Yo ukaak nimam ve upan zi,
ve tisov tighan le apozi isuŋ.
Ŋgar isov tau Yoova ighamgham zi na, ene iduduuŋ mon,
ve itotoi ighe i loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni ariaaŋ ve iuluul zi.
Tamtamon tisov tau ighe titaŋ raraini pa uleeŋ toman lolozi,
ene i ileep igharau zi ve iuluul zi.
Ve yes tau tiroi pani ve titaghon ŋgar tooni na, isaav ighe lolozi pa gabua eta ve tighasoni pani, ene i aat ilooŋ zi ve igham gabua tana pazi.
I iloŋlooŋ taŋiiz toozi, ve iuluul zi.
Tauvene yes tau lolozi igheen tooni na, i maata pazi ve imin sigheu pazi.
Eemon zeran sasaghati, i aat ivaghamun zi tisov tilalez.
Avog pale ipait Yoova.
Ve gabua naol isov tau i ighur zi na paam, aat tisov tipait eeza patabuyaaŋ. Ta aazne, ve taghon taghon gha ila.
